top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Jump Keeps Bond Yields Elevated: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A fresh bout of bond volatility left traders unwilling to make riskier bets, with stocks falling on worries that an oil rally will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Odd Lots: Richmond Fed CEO on Weathering Inflationary Shocks
top_signals.summary: On today's Odd Lots podcast, Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, to discuss why he thinks the current waves of inflationary shocks are normal and what the Fed needs to do to weather the storm. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Gold falls to two-week low as rising Treasury yields, dollar weigh - Reuters
top_signals.summary: Gold falls to two-week low as rising Treasury yields, dollar weigh  Reuters
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan arrests man in Iwate twice for hamster massacres
top_signals.summary: Police say the man teamed up with two different women on separate occasions and killed dozens of hamsters in a violation of animal protection laws.
